description:
A 20L hiking backpack is the right bag for the short, sharp hikes most of us do around Nairobi: half a day on Ngong Hills, a morning loop in Karura or a quick climb up Mt Longonot. You need water, a snack and a light jacket, not a big rucksack bouncing on your back the whole way.

The Nepal 20L hiking backpack keeps things simple. Twenty litres holds the essentials for a few hours on the trail and stays light and compact, so it moves with you on steep, rocky sections instead of pulling you backwards. It is also small enough to double as an everyday bag for work, school or travel.

Why Choose the Nepal 20L Hiking Backpack?

Most people overpack for short hikes because their only bag is too big. A 20L hiking backpack forces smart packing: two litres of water, a rain shell, a fleece, snacks, sunscreen and a phone, and nothing extra. Less weight means more energy for the climb and less strain on your shoulders on the way down.

If you need more room for full-day hikes, compare it with our 28L day hiking backpack or the Millet 30L hiking backpack. For hot trails where water is the main load, a 3L hydration backpack is another good option.

Key Features

  • 20-litre capacity, ideal for half-day and short day hikes
  • Compact, lightweight daypack that stays close to your back
  • Room for water, a rain jacket, a warm layer and snacks
  • Doubles as a work, school, gym or travel bag
  • Easy to carry on a matatu, boda or as cabin luggage
  • Quality hiking gear at a fair Nairobi price

Benefits of a 20L Hiking Backpack

Here is why a 20L hiking backpack is the go-to size for short trails.

  • Light on your back: A small pack keeps the load low, so you climb faster and feel fresher at the top.
  • Better balance: A compact bag does not sway on scrambles, rocky steps or steep descents.
  • Smart packing: Twenty litres fits the essentials and stops you carrying things you will never use.
  • Everyday use: Take it from the trail to the office, the gym or a weekend trip.
  • Easy travel: It fits under a bus seat or in an overhead bin without fuss.

Perfect For

  • Half-day hikes and short day hikes near Nairobi
  • Beginners joining their first guided group hike
  • Summit pushes when the main pack stays at camp
  • Runners, walkers and cyclists who want a light bag
  • Students, commuters and travellers who want one versatile daypack

Where to Use Your 20L Hiking Backpack in Kenya

A 20L hiking backpack is made for Nairobi's favourite short hikes: Ngong Hills, Mt Longonot crater rim, Oloolua Nature Trail, Karura Forest, Kereita Forest and Ol Donyo Sabuk. It is also a good summit bag on longer treks, for the final push to Point Lenana on Mt Kenya or to the top of Elephant Hill, when you leave the big rucksack behind.

Off the mountain, it suits Hell's Gate hiking and cycling days, Kakamega Forest walks, coastal trips to Diani and Watamu, and city days in Nairobi. Small enough for a matatu, strong enough for the trail.

Even on a short hike, pack the basics. The Ten Essentials list from the US National Park Service is a reliable checklist of what should be inside your daypack, from navigation and sun protection to extra water and a warm layer. Add good merino wool hiking socks and a rain layer and you are set for most Kenyan trails.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is a 20L hiking backpack big enough for a day hike?

For half-day and most short day hikes, yes. A 20L hiking backpack holds two litres of water, snacks, a rain jacket and a light fleece. For long, cold days with lunch and extra layers, a 28-30L pack gives more room.

What should I pack in a 20L daypack?

Water, snacks, a rain jacket, a warm layer, sunscreen, a hat, a small first aid kit, a headlamp and your phone. That covers most hikes around Nairobi.

Can I use it as an everyday bag?

Yes. Its compact size makes it a practical bag for work, school, the gym and short trips.
